name: Gears, Belts, Chains, Clutches & Brakes
summary: Designing power-transmission elements: gears of every type, gearboxes, flexible drives, clutches, brakes and flywheels.

topics.name: Gear types and nomenclature; involute profile and conjugate action
Spur gear geometry: contact ratio, interference and undercutting
Force analysis of spur, helical, bevel and worm gears
AGMA bending and contact (pitting) stress for spur and helical gears
Gearbox design and planetary gear sets
Gear manufacturing, quality grades, lubrication and failure modes
Specialised reducers: harmonic (strain-wave) and cycloidal drives
Belt drives: flat, V- and synchronous (timing) belts
Clutches and brakes: friction analysis, energy dissipation and temperature rise
